name: CoNLL-2015 Shallow Discourse Parsing Shared Task
description: Nianwen Xue, Hwee Tou Ng, Sameer Pradhan, Rashmi Prasad, Christopher Bryant, Attapol Rutherford. Proceedings of the Nineteenth Conference on Computational Natural Language Learning - Shared Task. 2015.
notes: Relatively small, expert-annotated dataset for shallow discourse parsing; explicit discourse relations are easier and closer to saturation while implicit relation identification remains challenging. Not an LLM-specific benchmark; domain/annotation complexity can limit cross-domain generalization.
